attacks.name: Blitz Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Blitz|: After this attack is resolved, Push the defender |!range_small|. Then this character may Advance |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Kneel Before Me!
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: World Domination (Affiliation: Hydra)
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, allied characters gain 1 |!power| if they are holding or Contesting an objective token.

superPowers.name: All-Consuming Obsession
superPowers.body: This character suffers 1 |!damage| and gains 2 |!power|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Empowered Gauntlets
superPowers.body: When this character makes a |*Blitz Strike| attack, before the |*Resolve Criticals| step, it may use this superpower. Treat each |!failure| result currently in the roll as a |!critical| result for the remainder of the attack.

superPowers.name: Leviathan Armor
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character chooses a Shielding Type. The chosen benefits last until the start of the next Power Phase:|\||~ &*Dispersion Field& - This character rolls 3 additional dice when defending against &!energy& attacks and cannot be Pushed or Advanced by the effects of enemy &!mystic& attacks or enemy superpowers.||\||~ &*Null Field& - This character rolls 3 additional dice when defending against &!mystic& attacks and does not suffer collision &!damage&.|

superPowers.name: Cut Off One Head...
superPowers.body: If an allied |£hydra-troopers-grunts£&*Hydra Troopers&| is not in play when this character is chosen to Activate, Place them into play within |!range| 1 of this character. They gain the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition and are part of your Squad.

erratas.body: Blitz Strike's Push special rules was merged into the Blitz special rule. Push previously was Away, and required the defender to be Size 3 or less and was triggerd by |!block| |!hit|.
Kneel Before Me!'s changed from |!energy| to |!mystic|. The former version allowed the attacker to choose between |!energy| and |!mystic| attack types.
Kneel Before Me!'s Throw now triggers before |!damage| is dealt instead of after the attack is resolved.

Empowered Gauntlets reworked: it is now a Reactive superpower that can be used when making a Blitz Strike attack. It treats |!failure| rolled before the |*Resolve Criticals| step as |!critical| results instead of counting Blank results as successes.
